author: Peter
title: Generative AI Product Displacement Risk
rq: Do equity investors price the risk that a firm's *product* (not its labor) is displaced by generative AI — and when does the market react?
finding: AI-PDR (products' digital deliverability, LLM-scored from 10-Ks) predicts ~10pp lower CARs at the open-source Cowork Plugins launch; general model releases don't reprice it; supply-side shields attenuate ~37%.
remember: Cowork Plugins = open-source complements → 'commoditize your complement' at the product level. Pair AI-PDR with my OSS-release / Data-Power setting; event targets products, not just capability.

author: Hanjun
takeaway: Accounting-based anomaly signals are highly predictable before their public release, but the easily predictable component has largely been arbitraged away in recent years, leaving returns concentrated in hard-to-forecast signals and surprises.
best: The striking result is that a trivial martingale rule—essentially carrying forward the prior-quarter ranking—matches sophisticated ML at about 72% F1, while the rare forecast misses generate disproportionately large returns.
idea: Can cross-sectional differences in signal predictability/persistence explain where anomaly profits survive—i.e., are the economically important returns increasingly tied to information that cannot be anticipated from stale signals?

author: Hanjun
title: Anomalies and News
finding: Anomaly returns are most consistent with mispricing explanations. Anomaly returns are 50% higher on corporate news days and 6 times higher on earnings announcement days.
remember: Follow the original literature to construct the anomaly portfolio. "Net" Variable (Long - Short).

author: Peter
title: Artificial Intelligence, firm growth, and product innovation
rq: Does the adoption of AI technology provide growth opportunity of firm?
finding:
1. Firm with higher AI investment experience higher growth in sales, employment, and market valuation.
2. AI is a general purpose technology.
3. It is driven by product innovation.
remember: What would be the negative/down side of AI adoption in firms? Any tradeoff?

author: Peter
title: Two-sided Network Effects: A Theory of Information Product Design
rq: What is the strategic pricing behavior and product design in network market?
finding:
1. Free goods market can exist when cross-market network externality's benefit outweigh the cost of it.
2. Consumer surplus is positive when firm gains at the same time.

author: Hanjun
title: Persistent and transitory component of firm characteristic: Implications for asset pricing
rq: Which component is dominant in explaining anomaly returns? persistent vs. transitory component of firm characteristics.
finding: The relative compensation for persistent and transitory component varies strongly across characteristics.
remember: They use 56 anomalies, and use new/old stocks sort inside the original anomaly portfolios.
